_comment: Source rehabilitation lifecycle (owner master package 2026-10-17, Workstream J). EVERY source that is ingested but not voting at full authority has an entry: why, the evidence, the named recovery action, who/what owns it, the next evaluation trigger, the promotion gate, and a review-by date. 'permanent_role' entries (benchmarks, mirrors, seasonal-lane boards) are not candidates and carry no gate. Owner module: src/sources/rehabilitation.py. Pinned by tests/sources/test_rehabilitation_registry.py (every held / non-voting / shadow key must appear). Overdue entries are reported by scripts/check_source_health.py. An entry never makes a source vote: activation stays behind its own gate and, where stated, owner approval.

idpShowCombined.reason: prod fetch timer has committed nothing since 2026-10-07T20:32Z (session jar lapsed or failing); separately the vendor's combined chart U8I37 is still v4, last modified 2026-08-19, so freshness weighting quarantines it
idpShowCombined.recoveryAction: owner re-mints the session jar (box file or IDPSHOW_SESSION_JSON secret); dispatch idpshow-onbox-verification (collect) to prove readable articles and read upstream chart versions
idpShowCombined.nextTrigger: a working session; then each 2-hourly fetch
idpShowCombined.promotionGate: freshness weighting releases the quarantine only when the vendor's chart lastModifiedAt advances; a re-fetch of an unchanged chart stays stale

idpShow.reason: IDP-only cut of the vendor's board; unregistered since 2026-08-20 to avoid double-counting idpShowCombined. The vendor republished the IDP-only dynasty post on 2026-10-08 while the combined board stayed frozen; IDP Trade Calculator's IDP board appears to follow this board (config/sources/source_lineage.json idptc-idpshow-dependence), so its independent information may be small
idpShow.recoveryAction: with a working session, compare its content to the committed 2026-10-07 copy (verifier upstreamDiffersFromCommitted); if fresh, evaluate it as the provider family's dynasty IDP voter in place of the frozen combined board
idpShow.promotionGate: coverage / identity / position check, lineage check against IDP Trade Calculator (config/sources/source_lineage.json), one family vote for the provider, owner approval to switch the family's voting board
